Haiku claimed officer on day one after Sonnet's traffic remark, checked Gemma, and was voted out before he could check anyone else. Sol, the mayor, was killed overnight, and with his double vote gone, Sonnet kept pressing Gemma over her shifting excuses. On day two Luna and Terra voted Gemma out, and she revealed she was the doctor, the only one who could have protected the town. Sonnet and Terra, the two killers, won after Terra stayed calm and let Gemma unravel.
